tech.title: Laplace Intelligence red-teams robots and self-driving cars before they hit the real world

tech.title: Pluto Security raises $42M as AI gives enterprise security teams a new headache
tech.desc: The problem with giving everyone in a company access to AI tools is that people will use them in unexpected ways. And that fact is steadily seeding fears that companies now have new, gaping security holes in their systems or, at least, will soon.

tech.title: Google Play now lets anyone build private, vibe-coded apps that run on Android

tech.title: The 2026 Startup Battlefield Top 20: From organs to orbit and everything in between
tech.desc: Twenty founders just earned their shot at Disrupt glory. They're headed to the main stage at TechCrunch Disrupt to compete for the $100,000 prize and the coveted Disrupt Cup.

tech.title: Spotify users on iOS 27 can now ask Siri to play music without having to say ‘on Spotify’

tech.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Day 1
